Gatlinburg, TN.restrictions: Must register with city. Annual permit required.
Gatlinburg, TN.notes: STR-friendly market. Cabins are a major tourism driver.

Pigeon Forge, TN.restrictions: Must register with city. Annual permit required.
Pigeon Forge, TN.notes: Very STR-friendly. Tourism is the primary economy.

Destin, FL.restrictions: Florida requires state-level DBPR license. Some HOAs restrict STR.
Destin, FL.notes: Check HOA/condo rules carefully. State license is straightforward.

Panama City Beach, FL.restrictions: Florida requires state-level DBPR license. Some areas restrict STR.
Panama City Beach, FL.notes: Generally STR-friendly. Verify zoning for specific address.

Kissimmee, FL.restrictions: STR allowed in designated resort zones. Restricted in residential areas.
Kissimmee, FL.notes: Focus on properties in resort-zoned communities near Disney.

Gulf Shores, AL.permit_type: City rental permit + state lodging license
Gulf Shores, AL.restrictions: Must obtain city permit and state lodging license. Annual renewal.
Gulf Shores, AL.notes: STR-friendly beach market. Strong vacation rental tradition.

Scottsdale, AZ.restrictions: Arizona SB1168 allows STR statewide but cities can impose regulations. Must pay TPT tax. Nuisance complaints can lead to penalties.
Scottsdale, AZ.notes: Legal statewide but city has added enforcement rules. Register and comply with noise/parking rules.

Joshua Tree, CA.restrictions: County caps number of STR permits. Must apply and may be waitlisted. Host must be reachable within 30 mins.
Joshua Tree, CA.notes: Permit availability varies. Check current cap status before purchasing.

Big Bear Lake, CA.permit_type: City of Big Bear Lake vacation rental permit
Big Bear Lake, CA.restrictions: City has a cap on STR permits. Must apply through city. Occupancy limits apply.
Big Bear Lake, CA.notes: Limited permits available. Verify permit transferability with purchase.

Mount Pocono, PA.restrictions: Regulations vary by township. Most Pocono townships allow STR with registration.
Mount Pocono, PA.notes: Generally permissive. Check specific township ordinances.

Kill Devil Hills, NC.restrictions: Must obtain rental permit. Properties must meet safety inspection standards.
Kill Devil Hills, NC.notes: OBX is a major vacation rental market. Very STR-friendly.

Branson, MO.restrictions: Must obtain business license for rental activity. Lodging tax applies.

Myrtle Beach, SC.restrictions: STR allowed in commercially-zoned and resort areas. Restricted in some residential zones.
Myrtle Beach, SC.notes: Verify zoning for specific property. Resort areas are safe bets.
